assets.alt: Hospital foundation sidebar crop showing Working 1/2, Wood 2/3 and construction health.

assets.caption: The first tutorial mission is selected before starting.

assets.caption: One swarm, one worker, and a small patch of revealed land: the tutorial starting colony.

assets.caption: The inn foundation shows its wood requirement and requested workers in the sidebar.
assets.alt: Selected inn construction site showing Working 0/3, wood 0/3 and construction health.

assets.caption: The completed inn has food in stock and workers assigned to hauling.
assets.alt: Completed inn beside the swarm; sidebar shows Food 5/10 and Working 2/2.

assets.caption: Use the upper Working row for staffing; the three lower bars set future production.
assets.alt: Selected swarm with the Working row, food display and Worker, Explorer and Warrior production bars.

assets.caption: The completed hospital supplies healing alongside the inn and swarm.
assets.alt: Selected hospital showing full health and room for two globs, with nearby inn and swarm.

assets.caption: Explorer production is set separately from the worker hauling food to the swarm.
assets.alt: Selected swarm with its Working request and the three unit production ratio controls visible.

assets.caption: Two explorers have revealed food, forests and stone beyond the starting clearing.
assets.alt: Expanded tutorial terrain and minimap; the top status bar shows two explorers and the swarm is selected.

assets.caption: Give the local browser save a recognizable name before confirming.
assets.alt: Save game dialog with the name field and confirmation controls.

assets.caption: A two-colony practice setup: You against a Numbi Easy AI, using Standard rules.
assets.alt: Players and Teams tab with two colonies, one controlled by You and the other by Numbi Easy; Standard shown above.

assets.caption: An explorer reveals terrain beyond the colony.
assets.alt: Tutorial colony with an explorer flying beyond the original visible clearing.

assets.caption: An explorer leaves the colony and uncovers terrain while workers continue their jobs. This 18-second clip has no audio.
assets.alt: An explorer flies around the tutorial colony and reveals nearby terrain; workers carry food to the inn and swarm.

assets.caption: Pause local practice to inspect the minimap, construction panel, and top counters.
assets.alt: Paused practice colony with a swarm, four workers, top counters, minimap and construction sidebar.

assets.caption: A selected swarm exposes Working, priority, food, and future-production controls.
assets.alt: Selected tutorial swarm with Working 1/1, food stock and three unit production ratio bars.

assets.caption: The text statistics view summarizes the colony; click its page heading to inspect other measurement groups.
assets.alt: Practice colony with text statistics showing four workers, three free workers and no hungry or wounded units.

assets.caption: Detail: the Colony page separates worker availability, health, and training counts.
assets.alt: Colony statistics sidebar showing four workers, three free, zero hungry, zero starving and zero wounded.

assets.caption: Detail: Working is staffing; Priority chooses hiring preference; Food and the three production bars report separate functions.
assets.alt: Selected swarm sidebar showing Working 1/1, low/medium/high priority, Food 4/20, and Worker, Explorer and Warrior production bars.

assets.caption: Workers carry wheat to a completed inn. Food 2/10 is stored food; Inside 2/4 records globs eating.
assets.alt: Selected inn near wheat; two workers carry loads and the sidebar shows Food 2/10, Working 2/2 and Inside 2/4.

assets.caption: The inn is still a construction site: two of three wood have arrived, with one worker attached to a request for three.
assets.alt: Inn foundation next to wheat, selected panel showing Wood 2/3, Working 1/3 and construction health 135/200.

assets.caption: Detail: wood deliveries build the inn before its food service can begin.
assets.alt: Construction panel crop with Wood 2/3 and Working 1/3.

assets.caption: Both inns are completed. The lower inn is farther from the revealed wheat; its first food deliveries are still on their way.
assets.alt: Two completed inns, the lower selected with Food 0/10, two attached workers carrying wheat across the colony.

assets.caption: Detail: the farther inn now holds Food 2/10 and has two workers attached to its request for two.
assets.alt: Completed inn panel crop showing Food 2/10, Inside 0/4 and Working 2/2.

assets.caption: A full food stock does not require every requested worker to remain attached; read the stock and diagnostic messages together.
assets.alt: Near inn panel crop with Food 10/10, Inside 2/4, Working 0/3 and fruit access messages.

assets.caption: After more travel time, food has arrived at the farther inn. Compare the delivery route, not just the building count.
assets.alt: Selected farther inn with Food 2/10 and two food-hauling workers, nearby hospital and nearer inn visible.

assets.caption: Workers bring wheat to the newly completed farther inn.
assets.alt: Two workers carrying wheat toward the selected farther inn.

assets.caption: Workers carry food along the longer route to the lower inn. The selected Food count changes as deliveries arrive. This 15-second clip has no audio.
assets.alt: Workers walk from the wheat at the upper right to the farther lower inn while its selected food stock changes.

assets.caption: A war flag requests warriors; this colony has only workers, so Working remains 0/10.
assets.alt: Selected war flag near a swarm with Working 0/10, Range 4 and minimum level 1; two workers and no warriors in the top counters.

assets.caption: Detail: staffing, priority, range, and minimum-level filters are separate controls.
assets.alt: War flag panel showing On the way 0, Here 0, Working 0/10, Range 4 and level 1 selected.

assets.caption: Paint a small guard area with the blue brush; warriors must be available to use it.
assets.alt: Blue guard area brush selected in flags sidebar, with one blue square painted near the colony.

assets.caption: Detail: choose the area tool, add/remove mode, and brush before painting.
assets.alt: Guard area selected in sidebar, with Adding areas selected and a single-square brush selected.

assets.caption: The completed inn is receiving wheat: Food 3/10, Working 2/2, Inside 0/4.
assets.alt: Selected completed inn beside revealed wheat with three food stored and two attached haulers.

assets.caption: Read Food, Working and Inside separately.
assets.alt: Inn panel crop showing Food 3/10, Working 2/2 and Inside 0/4.

assets.caption: The swarm holds Food 4/20 for births while the inn has its own meal stock.
assets.alt: Selected swarm beside an inn, with four food stored, one attached worker and three production controls.

assets.caption: Swarm food produces units; it does not feed existing globs.
assets.alt: Swarm panel showing Food 4/20 and Worker, Explorer and Warrior weight controls.

assets.caption: With hauling paused, meals have reduced the reserve from ten to seven; one glob is inside.
assets.alt: Inn panel showing Working 0/0, Food 7/10 and Inside 1/4.

assets.caption: Restoring the inn request and releasing swarm labor replenished the reserve to Food 10/10.
assets.alt: Selected inn with Food 10/10 and Inside 1/4, with Working request two; swarm and wheat remain visible.

assets.caption: The inn is full again. Unavailable fruit messages describe another resource request.
assets.alt: Inn panel with Food 10/10, Working 0/2 and unavailable fruit messages.

assets.caption: The same shoreline at two times. Harvesting and growth change known wheat; the newly revealed lower area is exploration, so its extra wheat does not demonstrate regrowth.
assets.alt: Side-by-side crops of the same wheat shoreline earlier and later, with more lower terrain revealed later.

assets.caption: Worker-only production is enabled; Working requests the worker who supplies the swarm.
assets.alt: Selected swarm with food stock and Worker-only birth mix, next to a completed inn.

assets.caption: Three birth weights are separate from the Working request.
assets.alt: Crop of swarm panel showing Working, Food and Worker, Explorer and Warrior controls.

assets.caption: Worker-only production increased the worker total from six to eight.
assets.alt: Selected swarm, new workers around the colony and top worker total eight.

assets.caption: The worker total is now eight; the explorer total is still zero.
assets.alt: Top bar crop showing worker availability five of total eight and explorer total zero.

assets.caption: After deliveries and production time, the first explorer has been born.
assets.alt: Selected swarm with Explorer-only weight, top explorer total one, and a flying explorer beyond the lake at right.

assets.caption: The explorer counter confirms a real birth: one explorer now exists.
assets.alt: Top bar crop showing eight workers and one explorer.

assets.caption: All birth weights are zero. Existing units remain in the colony.
assets.alt: Selected swarm panel crop with all three production controls at zero.

assets.caption: After running with births stopped, the totals remain eight workers and one explorer.
assets.alt: Top bar crop with eight workers and one explorer after an interval with production weights zero.

assets.caption: A school foundation needs both wood and algae before it can train anyone.
assets.alt: Selected school construction site near inn, swarm and wheat.

assets.caption: Wood 7/7 has arrived, but Algae remains 0/2 and the resource-distance message explains the stall.
assets.alt: School construction panel showing full wood requirement, no algae and distance-related warning.

assets.caption: The hospital is completed, with two healing places available and no patients inside yet.
assets.alt: Selected finished hospital beside an unfinished school and supplied inn, Inside 0/2.

assets.caption: A basic finished hospital shows patients in Inside; it does not need a food-hauling request.
assets.alt: Hospital panel with HP 260/260, Inside 0/2 and armor 5.

assets.caption: After clearing work, two globs are using the hospital. The inn remains a separate meal service.
assets.alt: Selected hospital Inside 2/2 near clearing flag and inn; surrounding tree patch has been cleared.

assets.caption: Both healing places are occupied: Inside 2/2.
assets.alt: Hospital panel crop showing Inside 2/2 and service progress.

assets.caption: After releasing the clearing job and letting services run, the hospital is empty again.
assets.alt: Hospital panel showing Inside 0/2 after the healing observation interval.

assets.caption: The school needs seven wood and two algae. Both kinds are arriving at this reachable shoreline site.
assets.alt: School construction site near two inns, with Wood 3/7 and Algae 1/2.

assets.caption: The completed school has three globs inside its four service places.
assets.alt: Finished school beside supplied inns, selected panel HP 360/360 and Inside 3/4.

assets.caption: Inside 3/4 records service occupancy, rather than construction labor.
assets.alt: School service panel showing three occupied training places.

assets.caption: An ordinary worker has Build (1): 8 before school training.
assets.alt: Worker ability panel showing Walk (1): 16 and Build (1): 8.

assets.caption: A worker that has completed training now shows Build (2): 12.
assets.alt: Trained worker ability panel showing Walk (1): 16 and Build (2): 12.

assets.caption: Before any worker qualified for the next tier, this healthy inn had no Upgrade action.
assets.alt: Level-one inn panel with Food 10/10 and Destroy button, without an Upgrade button.

assets.caption: After school training, the inn offers Upgrade. Keep the other supplied inn operating before using it.
assets.alt: Level-one inn with Food 9/10 and newly available Upgrade button.

assets.caption: The inn is now a level-two construction site. Two workers are attached and three of eight wood have arrived.
assets.alt: Selected upgraded inn site above a separate finished inn and school; Working 2/2, Wood 3/8.

assets.caption: Requesting two workers produced Working 2/2 here; the remaining requirement is five wood.
assets.alt: Level-two inn construction panel with HP 314/500, Working 2/2 and Wood 3/8.

assets.caption: The upgraded inn is complete and already stocked with fourteen food. The backup inn stayed separate throughout construction.
assets.alt: Completed level-two inn, school and separate level-one inn around the swarm.

assets.caption: The finished inn has seven meal places and capacity for thirty food. Read its new Working request after completion.
assets.alt: Inn Level 2 panel with HP 500/500, Inside 0/7, Working 3/3 and Food 14/30.

assets.caption: An exploration flag asks scouts to inspect the chosen region; the blue circle shows its work radius.
assets.alt: Exploration flag east of the colony with a large blue radius; two explorers visible around base.

assets.caption: After play resumes, both explorers are attached to the flag and more ground around its destination is visible.
assets.alt: Selected exploration flag with Working 2/2 and Here 2; two explorers inside the radius and nearby resources revealed.

assets.caption: Detail: this flag accepts any explorer, requests two, and uses Range 10.
assets.alt: Exploration flag panel with Working 2/2, Here 2, Range 10 and any explorer selected.

assets.caption: Watch the scouts move into their assigned region.
assets.alt: Exploration flag radius beside the colony, before the scouts move.

assets.caption: The explorers travel through the flag radius and reveal nearby terrain. This 10-second clip has no audio.

assets.alt: Cyan attackers at the lost inn sites; the selected surviving hospital reports Inside 2/2.

assets.caption: Detail: Inside 2/2 means both hospital places are occupied. It does not indicate a stored food supply.
assets.alt: Hospital panel with HP 260/260, Inside 2/2 and Armour 5.

assets.caption: The first raid is already inside the food corridor. The selected inn still has food and two globs inside.
assets.alt: Cyan attackers among red defenders beside two inns; selected inn shows Food 6/10 and Inside 2/4.

assets.caption: The attack overlaps the two inns and their working approach.
assets.alt: Cropped battle area showing cyan attackers, red warriors, a war flag and two inns.

assets.caption: Check readiness beyond the unit count: this warrior has 245/250 HP but only 29%food.
assets.alt: Selected red warrior panel showing HP 245/250, Food 29%, Walklevel 1 and attack traininglevel 2.

assets.caption: After the first exchange, both inns are gone and the selected warrior has 65/250 HP. The swarm is under attack.
assets.alt: Cyan attackers at the former inn sites, red survivors, selected warriorHP 65/250 and swarm under attack alert.

assets.caption: Losing the inns turns a fight into a food emergency for the remaining colony.
assets.alt: Battle detail with cyan attackers at the former inn locations and beside the remaining swarm.

assets.caption: The surviving hospital has two occupants. Healing capacity does not replace the lost inns.
